summary: Antigravity reviewed the accepted contract, C0 report, Q0 report, implementation plan, and cited mathematical authority in read-only mode. The E1-E7 mathematical gate is approved for implementation. Final V1 mathematical sign-off remains pending.

decisions.E1: Accept whole-district band feasibility as the delivered-map audit definition. Do not cite barman2023gac as an existence guarantee.
decisions.E2: Use the universal EFX removal quantifier and keep gain_matrix and legacy masked valuation conventions separate.
decisions.E3: Drop drivability because rep-home data is absent. Report band-only and band-plus-book-overlap results side by side.
decisions.E4: Reject unstaffable reservations. Use raw centered surplus, _match_masked, and a Hall-complete matching check. Do not clip or adjust per edge.
decisions.E5: Drop strict convexity. Verify positive matched surplus, Hall non-emptiness, total unimodularity, and conditioning.
decisions.E6: Use tools/measure/fefx.py and tests/test_fefx.py for this job, leaving U6-sel ownership intact.
decisions.E7: Define uniform mode as d_i = d_floor with gamma < 1 and use it as the clip-free fallback.

contract_corrections: Pin the legacy fairness regression anchor to masked valuation, total roster-size divisor, and 1e-12 slack.
Record reservation grain because R1 is state-grain and M1 is ZIP-grain.
Log the valuation convention for every audit result.
authorization: A1, R1, and M1 may proceed after these contract corrections; task dependencies still control dispatch order.

tests.command: agy --dangerously-skip-permissions --mode plan --model gemini-3.1-pro-high --output-format text --print=<read-only contract review>

followups: Final V1 Antigravity review is still required after implementation and benchmark evidence.
